text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER DELIVERY FAILURE: paging integration to external paging relay failed for service 'routing' (10:22:13 UTC). Attempts queued but not delivered.
Maya: seeing multiple alerts that on-call didn't get pages. Can someone confirm? :eyes:
Jake: I'm on it, checking the pager relay logs now — seeing 502s from the gateway since ~10:22.
Jake: tailing logs: 
```
2026-03-15T10:22:13Z WARN  pager-relay outgoing request failed status=502 body=Bad Gateway
2026-03-15T10:22:14Z ERROR deliver attempt id=abc123 err=\"upstream timeout\"
```
Sam: did we roll anything in the last hour? I don't see any deploys on eng-releases.
Liam: no deploys. We rotated the signing key for pager auth yesterday; could be a token/kid mismatch with the relay.
Jake: good call — auth service shows: 
```
ERROR auth-rotation: token validation failed issuer=pager-bridge err=\"kid not found\"
```
Maya: If pages aren't going out, we need manual escalation. Who's on-call? @Liam, can you call them?
Liam: paging on-call via phone now. also creating PD incident: PD-4132
Liam: Manual page sent to on-call (phone + SMS). Confirmed ack from on-call at 10:29.
incident-bot: NOTE: automatic incident channel actions (create-incident, assign-oncall) failed to complete because the webhook for the paging integration returned 502.
Pagerbot: relay healthcheck: upstream_retries_exceeded=7 last_status=502
Sam: customer impact: Support reported 5 customer-facing errors during the window, intermittent failures on inference requests that hit routed region us-west-2.
Maya: Can we reroute or fallback to a secondary paging provider while this is investigated? Any config flag we can flip?
Jake: There's a routing flag: `pager.relay.fallback_enabled` — currently false. I can flip it to true, but need ops approval for risk.
Maya: flip it, Jake. We need pages working ASAP. :thumbsup:
Jake: flipping now:
```
$ redis-cli set pager:relay:fallback_enabled true
OK
```
Jake: Confirmed downstream now routing through provider-b. Delivery attempts succeeding: status=200 observed.
Pagerbot: new deliveries: success_count=24 failure_count=0
Liam: thanks — on-call is back in the loop, coordinating with customer support to triage the 5 cases.
Maya: action items: 1) Postmortem for relay auth/key rotation vs token sync; 2) Set fallback_enabled default=true; 3) Improve alerts when bot automation actions fail (so we don't rely on single channel).
Sam: adding to incidents backlog and assigning to eng-infra. I'll create the ticket and attach logs.
Maya: anyone want to add notes about mitigation timeline for customer comms? Need precise window for public note.
Liam: mitigation window: 10:22 — 10:30 UTC when manual pages acknowledged. Noted.
incident-bot: Incident PD-4132 marked acknowledged by on-call at 10:29 UTC
Maya: thanks everyone. I'll draft a short customer note for support. Follow-up sync at 14:00 UTC in #incidents.
